# Feature Request

## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Explain why this feature would be useful and how it would fit with Drumless's goals.

## Proposed Solution
If you have an idea on how this should work, describe it here.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Any mockups, screenshots, or additional context about the feature request.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] This feature aligns with Drumless's mission (drum separation + BPM + click track)
